prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Spectrum 2-3: page #FBF9FA, text #2D211F, accent #86851D, secondary surface #E7EFE8, text on accent #111111. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Inter; narrow display hierarchy with neutral body text. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 14px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
